next.reason: 1985: file-name-1 in a USE statement 'must not cause the simultaneous request for execution of more than one USE procedure'; 1985 IX.4.8.4 lets a file-name USE coexist with an open-mode USE (the file-name one applies), so the rule refuses a file-name in two USE statements. 2023: 'The same file-name shall not appear in more than one USE AFTER EXCEPTION statement' (§2023:14.9.49.3 SR8), the file-name USE 'takes precedence over any USE statements specifying an INPUT' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR5), and 'no other declaratives are executed' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR3). Same refusal, still a syntax rule.
